Hydrology / Peak Flow Estimation

FlowIQ — Stormwater Runoff Calculator

Rational Method implementation following the SANRAL Drainage Manual, Section 3.1.1 (6th ed., worked example verified) — including the 10%–85% slope method, catchment-characteristic runoff coefficients (Tables 3.3–3.5), and coordinate-based design rainfall lookup from the SA Weather Bureau TR102 station archive.
